 AFCON Qualifier: Eric Chelle Reveals Injury Behind George Ilenikhena’s Super Eagles Omission
 By Abiodun Ogunbayo - November 13, 2026 
 Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp 
 Super Eagles head coach Eric Chelle has clarified that an injury was responsible for George Ilenikhena’s absence from Nigeria’s squad for the upcoming 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers against Tanzania.
 READ ALSO: Eric Chelle Admits Late Arrivals Of Super Eagles’ Players Affected His Game Plan For Friday’s Clash With Tanzania | Sports247 Nigeria 
 Sports247 reports that the young forward’s omission had generated questions among Nigerian football followers, with Chelle using his pre-match press conference to explain the situation and urge people not to jump to conclusions.
 Addressing the speculation, the Franco-Malian coach disclosed that Ilenikhena is currently nursing an injury, which affected his availability for the national team.
 “I saw lots of people speak about why George Ilenikhena is not here. Do you know that he has an injury?
 “Before, some of you didn’t know. I think everybody needs to stay calm,” Chelle said.
 The Super Eagles coach also spoke about his responsibility as the team’s manager, insisting that he is prepared to accept accountability for the team’s results.
 “If we win, this is the players’ credit, and if we lose, this is my responsibility, and I totally agree with that,” he added.
 Chelle’s comments provide clarification on Ilenikhena’s absence, putting to rest speculation that had surrounded the youngster’s omission from the squad.
 Nigeria are preparing for their AFCON 2027 qualifying fixture against Tanzania, with the technical crew focused on the players available for the assignment.
